caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic wall sconce featuring a large, round, reflective backplate with concentric, ridged designs along its circumference. Attached to the lower part of the backplate is a cylindrical candle holder supported by a narrow, flat metal strip that curves downward and outward before forming a loop that supports the base of the candle holder. The image is rendered in shades of gray and black on a plain, light-colored background, highlighting the reflective and metallic texture of the objects. The artist’s signature, “Amelia Toledo,” and the year “1138” appear in the bottom right corner.
title: Candle Sconce
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
